name: Volume percentage
author: Shirowwww
description: Shows Apple Music's volume as a percentage in the playback bar, next to the volume button, as Spicetify's Volume Percentage does.

fr.name: Volume en pourcentage
fr.description: Affiche le volume d'Apple Music en pourcentage dans la barre de lecture, à côté du bouton du volume, comme Volume Percentage sur Spicetify.

de.name: Lautstärke in Prozent
de.description: Zeigt die Lautstärke von Apple Music als Prozentwert in der Wiedergabeleiste neben der Lautstärketaste an, wie Volume Percentage von Spicetify.

es.name: Volumen en porcentaje
es.description: Muestra el volumen de Apple Music como porcentaje en la barra de reproducción, junto al botón del volumen, como Volume Percentage de Spicetify.

pt.name: Volume em porcentagem
pt.description: Mostra o volume do Apple Music em porcentagem na barra de reprodução, ao lado do botão de volume, como o Volume Percentage do Spicetify.

ru.name: Громкость в процентах
ru.description: Показывает громкость Apple Music в процентах на панели воспроизведения, рядом с кнопкой громкости, как Volume Percentage в Spicetify.

ja.name: 音量をパーセント表示
ja.description: Spicetify の Volume Percentage のように、Apple Music の音量を再生バーの音量ボタンの横にパーセントで表示します。

zh.name: 音量百分比
zh.description: 在播放栏的音量按钮旁以百分比显示 Apple Music 的音量，类似 Spicetify 的 Volume Percentage。

it.name: Volume in percentuale
it.description: Mostra il volume di Apple Music in percentuale nella barra di riproduzione, accanto al pulsante del volume, come Volume Percentage di Spicetify.

ko.name: 볼륨 퍼센트
ko.description: Spicetify의 Volume Percentage처럼 Apple Music의 볼륨을 재생 바의 볼륨 버튼 옆에 퍼센트로 표시합니다.
